name: Fycheck Outpost
title: Fycheck Outpost
summary: An abandoned Sho outpost on the north end of a 238 m ridge-top plateau: a palisade with the destroyed Eastham portal arch on the west, two Sho halls, a well and a Runed Chest; the ridge falls 140-180 m into gorges to the west.

landmarks.name: West palisade and destroyed Eastham portal
landmarks.note: Wall segments 0x01000E65/0x01000E77 and the wooden arch 0x0200004F.

landmarks.name: Western gorge
landmarks.note: The ridge falls 140-180 m to the gorge floor.

site.name: Fycheck Outpost
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer destroyed-eastham-portal (inside the west palisade). [critic b4-7 2026-10-15: teleport changed from '@teleloc 0xD0540014 56.772 76.887 238.005 -0.707107 0 0 -0.707107' because the gazetteer destroyed-eastham-portal drop stands in the Destroyed Eastham Portal (0.0 m, weenieType Portal). Derived drop 14.6 m south on the summit plateau (ground 238.0), 14.6 m from the portal, 6.1 m from the nearest tree. Cell index = floor(lx/24)*8+floor(ly/24)+1, z = ground + 0.5.]

shots.standingOrder: Cross Fycheck Outpost east-north-east 26 m above its courtyard from over the west palisade with the gimbal tracking through vertical; stay 11 m above the roofs.
shots.notes: Pass over the palisaded Sho outpost on the 238 m summit, from over the west wall and its destroyed Eastham portal arch across the courtyard; golden sun (0.78) behind the lens. Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 26..26 m, nearest drawn 12.77 m (static 0xD054#24 0x01000E01), vmax 5.5 m/s, LOS blocked 0/41, subject in frame 100%; edit 1.5-8 s: AGL 26..26 m, nearest drawn 12.77 m (static 0xD054#24 0x01000E01), vmax 5.5 m/s, LOS blocked 0/27, subject in frame 100%; flight cinema peak 5.51 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.02 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hover 34 m above the outpost on the summit and turn 120 degrees clockwise from south-east to west-south-west with the horizon level; the lens never moves and nothing is within 20 m.
shots.notes: Vista from the mountain top: the slice sweeps from the south ridge (Fycheck Ruins' tower 430 m away) to the deep western gorge and the low golden sun; the outpost itself is below frame by design (pano).
